label: Seven Fifth Way omission controls
meaning: All seven premises hold nonvacuously on the oneDirects fixture. Five no-director variants separately omit cognition-lack, populated observation, not-chance, chance-or-intention and the knowing-director premise; the existing two-archer/moved and no-moves fixtures omit reduction and directing-as-moving. Every omission lacks a first unmoved mover. The two-archer survivor has first movers but not global uniqueness. Predicates are fully interpreted; no empirical applicability or full-worldview consistency is claimed.
